en: Job 3

p.src: 1  After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

en: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.
u.src: 1  After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

p.src: 2  Job answered:

en: Job answered:
u.src: 2  Job answered:

p.src: 3  “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

en: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’
u.src: 3  “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

p.src: 4  Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

ja: みることのないように。 そこに光が輝くことのないように。
en: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.
u.src: 4  Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

p.src: 5  Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

ja: がそれをわがものとするように。
を黒くするすべてのものがそれを脅かすように。
en: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.
u.src: 5  Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

p.src: 6  As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

ja: らえるように。 それが
en: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.
u.src: 6  As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

p.src: 7  Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

ja: は実りなき夜となれ。 そこにいかなる
en: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.
u.src: 7  Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

p.src: 8  Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

ja: たち、 レビヤタンを
en: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.
u.src: 8  Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

p.src: 9  Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

ja: くなるように。 それが
んでも、何もないように。
en: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,
u.src: 9  Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

p.src: 10  because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

en: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.
u.src: 10  because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

p.src: 11  “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

ja: ななかったのか。 母が私を産んだとき、なぜ
en: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?
u.src: 11  “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

p.src: 12  Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

ja: け入れたのか。 なぜ
en: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?
u.src: 12  Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

p.src: 13  For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

ja: そうであったなら、私は
en: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,
u.src: 13  For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

p.src: 14  with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

ja: たちとともに。 彼らは
en: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;
u.src: 14  with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

p.src: 15  or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

ja: っていた君主たちとともに。 彼らは自分の
en: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;
u.src: 15  or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

p.src: 16  or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

ja: 私は、ひそかに葬られた
のようであればよかった。
en: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.
u.src: 16  or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

p.src: 17  There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

ja: 者は騒ぎをやめる。 そこでは、
en: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
u.src: 17  There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

p.src: 18  There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

ja: に安らぐ。 追い使う
en: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.
u.src: 18  There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

p.src: 19  The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

ja: もそこにいる。 しもべは
en: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.
u.src: 19  The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

p.src: 20  “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

en: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
u.src: 20  “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

p.src: 21  who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

ja: を探す以上に、彼らはそれを探し
en: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,
u.src: 21  who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

p.src: 22  who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

ja: つけることができれば、
en: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?
u.src: 22  who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

p.src: 23  Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

ja: えられるのか。 神がその道を閉ざされた人に。
en: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
u.src: 23  Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

p.src: 24  For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

ja: に先立って、ため息がもれ、
en: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.
u.src: 24  For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

p.src: 25  For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

en: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.
u.src: 25  For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

p.src: 26  I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

ja: けさも、安息もない。 ただ苦難がやって来る。
en: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
u.src: 26  I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”
